environment.build: PR #886 deployed (brands/logo returns the Logo API URL)
environment.test_aid: Test aid (whole run): the Brandfetch Logo CDN answers 302 x-bf-error "automated_traffic" to the MCP browser (HeadlessChrome user agent), so a Playwright context route rewrites ONLY the User-Agent of cdn.brandfetch.io requests to a standard Chrome UA, to reproduce what a real user's Chrome receives (200 image/png). No app request was changed.

prechecks.cdn_non_browser_ua: 302 -> https://docs.brandfetch.com/docs/logo-link/guidelines#2-hotlinking, x-bf-error: automated_traffic (HeadlessChrome, python-requests, node-fetch); user_agent_required (empty UA)

side_observations.entity_logo_url: GET /geo/api/v1/reports: analyses created from a suggestion store entityLogoUrl = search icon https://cdn.brandfetch.io/{brandId}/w/128/h/128/fallback/lettermark/icon.webp?c=<time-signed token>; only today's Zomato URL still loads, the 6 older ones (Nike, Decathlon x2, adidas, Orange, Toyota) fail (expired tokens, already known as 410). A1 "Lictorix Geo" + licter.com (custom brand, created 20/10 before the fix) has entityLogoUrl = null. Front bundle: create payload sends entityLogoUrl = selectedBrand.logoUrl (null for unbranded), so a custom brand created now would store the Logo API URL, also for domains where it answers 404 (not verified: Create not clicked).
side_observations.server_side_risk: The Logo CDN refuses non-browser clients (302 automated_traffic). Any server-side fetch of a stored Logo API URL (PPT/PDF export, GEO-1263) would get no image and must fall back.

results.title: Confirmed domain shows the logo preview in the brand card within moments

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Lictorix Geo" is selected with an empty website field
steps.expected: The 32px avatar shows the letter "L"
steps.observed: Avatar = green 32px lettermark "L", no domain under the name

steps.title: When the user types a valid domain in the website field
steps.expected: The avatar is unchanged while typing
steps.observed: Typed "licter.com" one character at a time: avatar unchanged (no DOM change recorded while typing)

steps.title: And the field loses focus
steps.expected: A grey pulsing placeholder of the same size replaces the avatar, with no text and no layout shift
steps.observed: Blur: at +26 ms the avatar becomes span.h-8.w-8.animate-pulse.rounded-full.bg-slate-200 (32x32, no text); domain "licter.com" appears; same 32x32 box, no layout shift

steps.title: Then the logo retrieved for the domain is displayed within moments
steps.expected: The 32px avatar shows the logo of licter.com, same place and size as the logo of a selected suggestion
steps.observed: At +163 ms img src = https://cdn.brandfetch.io/domain/licter.com/w/64/h/64/fallback/404/icon.png?c=1idqBOqddsIGy5EF11F, loaded at +267 ms (64x64 natural, real Licter logo). Position (635,249) and 32x32 identical to the selected suggestion "Licter / licter.com"

steps.title: And the domain is shown under the brand name
steps.expected: "licter.com"
steps.observed: "licter.com" under "Lictorix Geo"

steps.title: And the logo lookup requests are recorded
steps.expected: One logo lookup for licter.com is visible (request names noted for the other TCs)
steps.observed: 1 x GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com -> 200 {"domain":"licter.com","logoUrl":"https://cdn.brandfetch.io/domain/licter.com/w/64/h/64/fallback/404/icon.png?c=1idqBOqddsIGy5EF11F"}; then cdn.brandfetch.io/domain/licter.com (200 image/png) and www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64 (requested in parallel, 301)

results.notes: AC1 now verified: the real Brandfetch logo (Logo API, PR #886) is shown for a Custom Brand with a typed website. Placeholder captured from the DOM recorder (very short, ~140 ms). Side observation: the app requests the Google s2 favicon in parallel even when the CDN logo loads (prefetch, no visual effect). Test aid (whole run): the Brandfetch Logo CDN answers 302 x-bf-error "automated_traffic" to the MCP browser (HeadlessChrome user agent), so a Playwright context route rewrites ONLY the User-Agent of cdn.brandfetch.io requests to a standard Chrome UA, to reproduce what a real user's Chrome receives (200 image/png). No app request was changed.

results.title: Favicon is used when the brand logo service has no logo for the domain

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Lictorix Geo" is selected with an empty website field
steps.expected: The avatar shows the letter "L"
steps.observed: Avatar "L", website field empty

steps.title: When the user enters a domain unknown to the brand logo service and the field loses focus
steps.expected: The grey pulsing placeholder is shown
steps.observed: CSV W3 "sqlite.org": pulse placeholder shown at blur. Same for substitute "gnu.org"

steps.title: Then the site's favicon is shown as the brand visual
steps.expected: The 32px avatar shows the favicon of W3, not the letter "L"
steps.observed: W3 "sqlite.org" (CSV data): the card shows the BRANDFETCH logo of sqlite.org (CDN 200 image/png), not the favicon, because Brandfetch now has a logo for sqlite.org, so the precondition "domain unknown to the brand logo service" is not met. With "gnu.org" (CDN 404): img chain cdn.brandfetch.io (404) -> www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=gnu.org&sz=64 (via t2.gstatic.com faviconV2, 200) -> GNU head favicon shown, not "L"

steps.title: And the domain is shown under the brand name
steps.expected: The W3 domain
steps.observed: "sqlite.org" / "gnu.org" under the brand name

results.notes: AC2 favicon fallback is VERIFIED (CDN 404 -> onError -> Google favicon) with gnu.org, a domain that meets the step condition. PARTIAL only because the CSV data W3 = "sqlite.org" no longer qualifies (Brandfetch Logo API now returns a logo for it). Proposed CSV data fix: W3 = "gnu.org" (also checked: catb.org = CDN 404 + favicon). Needs user approval before the CSV is changed. Test aid (whole run): the Brandfetch Logo CDN answers 302 x-bf-error "automated_traffic" to the MCP browser (HeadlessChrome user agent), so a Playwright context route rewrites ONLY the User-Agent of cdn.brandfetch.io requests to a standard Chrome UA, to reproduce what a real user's Chrome receives (200 image/png). No app request was changed.
